readings: Join advancedbehavior to transactionrecord on translink = transreg and to trader on trdref = tradereg, keeping only matched rows. For each trader type present in the joined data, count distinct transactionrecord.transreg values with at least one advancedbehavior record, and divide that count by the total distinct matched trade records across all trader types to get its share. Find the average of these counts across the trader types present. For types with a count strictly above that average, return one row containing the sum of their counts, the arithmetic mean of their shares, and the arithmetic mean of the amount by which each count exceeds the overall average count. Do not round.

Join advancedbehavior to transactionrecord on translink = transreg and to trader on trdref = tradereg, keeping only matched rows. For each trader type present in the joined data, count advancedbehavior records linked to its trade records, counting multiple analyses of the same trade separately, and divide that count by the total matched advancedbehavior records across all trader types to get its share. Find the average of these counts across the trader types present. For types with a count strictly above that average, return one row containing the sum of their counts, the arithmetic mean of their shares, and the arithmetic mean of the amount by which each count exceeds the overall average count. Do not round.
queries:
WITH matched AS (
    SELECT tr.transreg, t.tradekind
    FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
    JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON ab.translink = tr.transreg
    JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
),
type_counts AS (
    SELECT tradekind, COUNT(DISTINCT transreg) AS trade_count
    FROM matched
    GROUP BY tradekind
),
overall AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT transreg) FROM matched) AS total_count,
        (SELECT AVG(trade_count) FROM type_counts) AS average_count
)
SELECT
    SUM(tc.trade_count),
    AVG(1.0 * tc.trade_count / o.total_count),
    AVG(tc.trade_count - o.average_count)
FROM type_counts AS tc
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE tc.trade_count > o.average_count;

WITH type_counts AS (
  SELECT t.tradekind, COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS a
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON a.translink = tr.transreg
  JOIN trader AS t ON tr.trdref = t.tradereg
  GROUP BY t.tradekind
),
totals AS (
  SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_count,
         AVG(record_count) AS average_count
  FROM type_counts
)
SELECT SUM(c.record_count),
       AVG(1.0 * c.record_count / totals.total_count),
       AVG(c.record_count - totals.average_count)
FROM type_counts AS c
CROSS JOIN totals
WHERE c.record_count > totals.average_count
